items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He had a brother named Wendell Carney

ctx.x: What I want to do now is to discuss your friendship with Harry Carney.

Harry Carney. Born April First -- no fool -- 1910. I guess he was born in Boston; that's where I met him. I don't know exactly where he was born. He had a brother named Wendell Carney, a beautiful mother and a beautiful daddy. As far as I know of them. He was brought up very strict by his mother.
He was a classmate of yours, too, wasn't he?
